spanish: Haga resplandecer Jehová sus faces a ti, y te haga gracia;

findings.issue: Qal jussive 3ms plus 2ms suffix is one verb of showing favor; Spanish splits it into the light verb haga and the noun gracia without a change of participants or stem force.

notes: Hiphil jussive, Jehová, plural faces with 3ms suffix, and אל plus 2ms match the tokens.
